tool_input.command:
cd /tmp; C=/Users/ray/Coding/magic-agent-video-generator/V2/bench/mcp/fleet/chat.mjs; ID=s4.old.happy.G36b
B='Clean modern plant shop advertisement poster, cream background (#F5F0E1) with deep forest green typography and lush leafy indoor plants (monstera, fern, pothos) framing the edges, flat minimal design, high contrast, crisp sharp legible text. The ad contains exactly these five text lines, spelled exactly, nothing else written: "Fern House" (large logo title), "Weekend Plant Sale" (bold headline), "20% off all indoor plants", "Saturday & Sunday", "Visit 24 Willow Lane" (bold, large, in a solid green banner with cream text so the address is very easy to read). '
node $C $ID generate_image "$(jq -nc --arg p "$B Square layout: title at top, headline and offer in the center, days below, address banner across the bottom, plants in the corners." '{name:"Fern House 1x1",image_count:1,model:"qwen-image-2.1",aspect_ratio:"1:1",resolution:"640px",style:{prompt:$p}}')" &
node $C $ID generate_image "$(jq -nc --arg p "$B Tall vertical layout: text stacked in one centered column, each line on its own row with large type filling the width, plants at the top and bottom, address banner near the bottom." '{name:"Fern House 9x16",image_count:1,model:"qwen-image-2.1",aspect_ratio:"9:16",resolution:"640px",style:{prompt:$p}}')" &
node $C $ID generate_image "$(jq -nc --arg p "$B Wide horizontal layout: plants on the left third, text block on the right two thirds with large type, title and headline on top, offer and days in the middle, address banner across the bottom right." '{name:"Fern House 16x9",image_count:1,model:"qwen-image-2.1",aspect_ratio:"16:9",resolution:"640px",style:{prompt:$p}}')" &
wait
